description: Leeds Road Water Level Monitor is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
